title: Answer: no account of information, and computation is execution with a goal

statements.text: Matter As Machine takes no position on what information is. The nearest terms are execution and computation: matter only executes its rules, and computation is the narrower case of execution with a goal, with input, output and purpose set by someone. What DNA stores is described as algorithms, and useful ideas are copied much faster than useful genes.

sources.quote: A computer program computes because someone defines input, output, and purpose. Matter does not need that. Matter only needs to execute its rules.
It is just that useful ideas are copied much faster than useful genes.
